svg.text: stearic acid 18:0: straight, packs tightly → high mp
α-linolenic 18:3 cis-Δ9,12,15: cis kinks, low mp
ω: count from the CH₃ end; 18 − 15 = 3 → ω-3
Phospholipase A₂ cuts the ester at sn-2:
Triacylglycerols store energy; phospholipids (polar head + two tails) build membranes.
Saturated tails stack closely: more dispersion contact, higher melting point.
